scope: Task board role within the active Day Zero work session
evidence: Current synthetic UI screenshots, PRD sections 5.1.2 and 5.2, task and agent implementation
verdict: Manual task entry should be secondary; explicit collaboration agreements should produce visible task records.

steps.name: Assignment and team conversation
steps.health: appropriate entry, task conversion shown on every message

steps.name: Task board
steps.health: primary friction: blank creation form precedes actual work status

steps.name: Shared proposal
steps.health: clear deliverable with owners and saving feedback

findings.finding: The first work screen emphasizes creating records rather than continuing the agreed work.
Users can repeat a decision in chat and a structured task form; direct entry is optional in code but visually appears to be a prerequisite.
Generic greetings expose the same task registration action as actual work agreements.
The owner label candidate and part linking terminology add tool-specific interpretation to the participant role.

recommendation: Keep participant choices about scope, order, assignment and agreement in the conversation.
Create one task from a clear work request or agreement, preserve its source, and ask only when assignment is ambiguous.
Use the board for ownership, progress, blockers and links to source conversations and work products.
Keep manual addition as a secondary option; do not prescribe a fixed task decomposition.
Update colleague completion from actual saved work rather than promises or generated prose.

accessibility.observed: Fields have labels; the current task form does not visibly distinguish required inputs before browser validation.
accessibility.risk: The accessibility observation still reports focus on the background submit button after the confirmation dialog opens; focus management needs a separate keyboard check.
accessibility.not_verified: Keyboard-only completion, screen-reader behavior and contrast compliance were not tested.

limits: No new model-mediated assignment-to-task execution was run during this audit.
No final submission or code modification performed.
